wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/obj/msg_a2s.txt: fix(php): `Array to string conversion` was raised NOWHERE, and through a boxed Mixed an array rendered as the EMPTY STRING

php raises `Array to string conversion` at every site that renders an array as a string and
answers the literal `Array`. Measured on `php -n` 8.5.6, one shape per line: `echo`, `print`,
`.`, `.=`, interpolation, a heredoc, `(string)`, `strval()`. All eight warnings were missing.

The boxed half was worse than a missing diagnostic — it was a WRONG VALUE:

    <?php function show(mixed $v) { echo "concat: " . $v . "\n"; echo $v; }
    show([1, 2]);
    php    concat: Array
